blocks.html: Drop range rings or a bullseye grid on the map to judge distance and sector to a point, then share it with your team.

slides.title: Drop a range ring circle
slides.html: Tap the Circle icon on the toolbar to turn the Circle Tool on (yellow), then tap the map for the centre. Tap the circle's centre to open its radial menu.

slides.title: Set radius and ring count
slides.html: On the radial, tap Details. Set the Radius, Rings count and unit. The circle redraws as specified and can be sent or broadcast to other users.

slides.title: Add a bullseye grid
slides.html: The Bullseye tool adds a circular grid with bearing lines every 30 degrees. Angles read either From Center (red, away) or toward the centre point (green).

slides.title: Adjust the bullseye
slides.html: Tap the bullseye centre for its radial. Use Range Rings to add rings, Angle Bearing Units to switch units, and Fine Adjust to nudge the centre.

slides.title: Set direction and send
slides.html: Tap Details. Set Direction (From Center or toward it), the angle units and Show Range Rings. Tap Send to broadcast the bullseye to other users.
